hypothesis: A deployable expected-physics command signal should be constructed explicitly by integrating historical out-of-fold/out-of-time physics-teacher predictions over a pitcher's completed-history repertoire, rather than asking a downstream CatBoost model to discover that integration from profile columns.

2020.protocol: physics teacher fit strictly on 2019 and scored on 2020

signals.all: season-centered physics-teacher mean by pitcher, K=200
signals.recent: latest completed-season pitcher mean shrunk to all-history with K=100
signals.context: pitcher x count pitch-group mixture with K=100 times pitcher x group teacher levels with K=100
